svg.title: Texture and stops, measured against their references
svg.desc: Eight measurements drawn as bars, each the Runsketch value as a share of its reference, with both raw numbers printed and the reference marked at 100 per cent. Seven sit just under or on the reference: speed around its 61-second average 4.09 against 4.42 per cent, speed correlation with the previous second 0.941 against 0.948, spread of the one-second speed change 0.047 against 0.048 metres per second, spread of the one-second heart-rate change 0.610 against 0.612 bpm, seconds with no heart-rate change 64.3 against 63.8 per cent, stops per kilometre 1.12 against 1.20, and mean wait at a stop 34.0 against 35 seconds. One overshoots: heart rate around its 61-second average is 1.988 bpm against the file's 1.496, about a third larger, and it is highlighted. Both sides of every comparison are measured over the same window, which matters because that statistic more than triples if the window is widened from 31 to 181 seconds.
